newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rain in Spain hits crops, triggers evacuation alert.
newsitem.headline: Rain in Spain hits crops, triggers evacuation alert.

text.p: People in Spain's central Madrid province were put on alert for possible evacuation as floodwater rose from relentless rains, civil protection authorities said on Tuesday.

As well as flood alerts in small villages and towns around Madrid, more than 60 roads and three rail lines have been cut by floodwater in the southern Andalusia region, hardest hit so far by more than a week of continual rains.
Rains were blamed for a train derailment in Granada province early on Tuesday.
More than 4,000 people in the south have been evacuated from homes and farmers' groups say crop damage there is extensive.
